pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation using a kitchen blender to reduce particle size.
Thermal pretreatment (TP) applied in an oven at temperatures of 60 °C, 80 °C, 100 °C, 120 °C and 140 °C with durations of 1 h for 60 and 80 °C, and 30 min for 100, 120 and 140 °C.

Biological pre-hydrolysis (BPH) carried out in 1 L glass vessels flushed with nitrogen (N2) in an incubator for 40 h at different temperature regimes: 37 °C, 55 °C, a sequence of 37 °C for 20 h followed by 55 °C for 20 h, and a sequence of 55 °C for 20 h followed by 37 °C for 20 h, using an inoculum at a food waste to inoculum ratio of 10:1 (w/w).
